subject.title: feat(ui): redesign Channels page with guided channel setup wizard

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a Control UI channel-setup wizard over the Gateway wizard protocol once account-scoped completion, cancellation, and no-change semantics are corrected?
rationale: This adds a substantial first-time setup surface and a new cross-client Gateway protocol contract; implementation repair cannot decide whether that permanent product/API direction is desired.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Keep the shared wizard direction, require the three correctness fixes and real Gateway proof, then complete maintainer protocol and UX review.

options.title: Pause the protocol expansion
options.body: Keep channel setup in the established CLI and docs until maintainers choose a narrower or different Control UI integration boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the shared wizard direction, require the three correctness fixes and real Gateway proof, then complete maintainer protocol and UX review.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent merged settings redesign and this proposed workflow make steipete the strongest available owner for the Control UI direction.
